schema.description: Design Parameters - Moment Redistribution Factor (MRFT). Only Beam Member Type is applicable. Supported methods: POST, GET, PUT, DELETE.

Assign.description: Object keyed by beam member ID strings (e.g., "859"), where each entry represents a moment redistribution factor assigned to the member. Only Beam Member Type is applicable.

FACTOR.description: Moment redistribution factor assigned to the member.
